purpose: P1 regional flow targets relative to cardiac output

renal_flow_fraction_of_cardiac_output.population_provenance: Western literature; de Leeuw et al. 1982
renal_flow_fraction_of_cardiac_output.direction_of_change: When explicitly enabled, the 0.80-0.90 preset raises renal flow from the current modifier-route observation (~0.722) toward the literature-derived range; it is an active physiological change, not exposure-only.

gut_flow_fraction_of_cardiac_output.population_provenance: No fixed resting target; Messerli/Sugawara evidence is stage- and output-dependent

liver_flow_fraction_of_cardiac_output.population_provenance: No fixed resting target; Messerli/Sugawara evidence is stage- and output-dependent

matched_comparison.map_boundary_note: MAP difference 0.494 mmHg is within the predeclared +/-0.5 tolerance and near its boundary.

implementation_rule: Target fields are optional; absent fields leave current engine behavior unchanged. Renal target is flow-relative-to-output; gut/liver remain proportional until separately justified.
parameter_semantics: Open-loop baseline-relative renal resistance adjustment; not an invariant flow target.
haemorrhage_comparison: Not feasible for honest Stage 5 comparison under open-loop design because MAP shifts with the adjustment; a MAP-forced rerun would represent a different phenotype.
pressure_domain_finding: At fixed systemic resistance, renal fraction tracks the adjustment monotonically; across rising systemic resistance, renal fraction rises from 0.139 to 0.170 despite the adjustment, demonstrating pressure-dependent interaction with the coupled baroreflex system.
